text: Who in this system is allowed to lock Aziz out of his own account?

text: In Lesson 33, a refresh that gives a different personal identification number ended in a block.

text: This lesson opens that block: who can set it, what it does at once, and who can lift it.

text: The list of who can block is short, and I think its shortness is the design.
prefix: The list of who can block is short, and I think its shortness is the design.

text: Only two: the platform itself, when a refresh gives a different personal identification number, and an operator, with a reason.
prefix: Only two: the platform itself, when a refresh gives a different personal identification number, and an operator, with a reason.

text: No other automatic block exists in this version.
prefix: No other automatic block exists in this version.

text: A number that the mobile operator gives to a new person never blocks its old owner.
prefix: A number that the mobile operator gives to a new person never blocks its old owner.

text: And a failed face check never blocks anybody.
prefix: And a failed face check never blocks anybody.

text: It only counts an attempt, for the phone number, the device and the personal identification number.
prefix: It only counts an attempt, for the phone number, the device and the personal identification number.

text: After the first counted failure and after the second, a cool-down starts, and after the daily cap no attempt is possible until the next day.

text: Only failures that the person or the capture caused are counted: a wrong document, a face that does not match, a poor image.

text: A failure that the service caused, like a timeout, is not counted.

text: Back to Aziz.
prefix: Back to Aziz.

text: The operator finds him in the panel and presses block, with the reason: phone stolen, customer request.
prefix: The operator finds him in the panel and presses block, with the reason: phone stolen, customer request.

text: Now watch what one block does.
prefix: Now watch what one block does.

text: It ends every access grant of Aziz, in every app, on every device.
prefix: It ends every access grant of Aziz, in every app, on every device.

text: It refuses every request from each of his devices, so the phone in the thief's pocket gets an error, not a balance.
prefix: It refuses every request from each of his devices, so the phone in the thief's pocket gets an error, not a balance.

text: It refuses a registration or a login with his number.
prefix: It refuses a registration or a login with his number.

text: It stops each open proofing session.
prefix: It stops each open proofing session.

text: It keeps his devices and his identity data, because a block is a pause, not a deletion.
prefix: It keeps his devices and his identity data, because a block is a pause, not a deletion.

text: It sends the security notification account blocked.
prefix: It sends the security notification account blocked.

text: It opens a case, or updates an open one.
prefix: It opens a case, or updates an open one.

text: And it writes an audit event and sends an event to the bank's antifraud system.
prefix: And it writes an audit event and sends an event to the bank's antifraud system.

text: How can all of that be true at the very next request?

text: The block makes three writes together: the customer state in Postgres, the sessions in Keycloak, and the outbox.
prefix: The block makes three writes together: the customer state in Postgres, the sessions in Keycloak, and the outbox.

text: The gateway also keeps a revocation list in Valkey, and every renewal passes the binding check first.

text: So the stop is real at the next request, even at the busiest hour.
prefix: So the stop is real at the next request, even at the busiest hour.

text: The operator path and the automatic path make the same three writes, and only the actor is different.
prefix: The operator path and the automatic path make the same three writes, and only the actor is different.

text: Now the case.

text: A case is the operator's folder for one problem.

text: It shows the customer, the trigger, the related values, masked, and the comparison notes.

text: Cases also open for other reasons: data that the customer refused, a stopped re-registration, a link that was refused or expired.

text: Phone reviews have their own list.

text: Each case ends with one result: no action, unblocked, link set by the bank, or customer contacted.

text: On Saturday, Aziz has a new phone with his old number.
prefix: On Saturday, Aziz has a new phone with his old number.

text: He calls again, and the operator unblocks him, with a reason.

text: An unblock makes the devices trusted again and sends the notification account unblocked, with no new proofing.

text: Read that once more: the devices.

text: All of them, and that includes the phone the thief has.

text: A block ends every session at the next request, keeps the data, and opens a case.

text: Only an operator unblocks, and the devices come back, except after a mismatch.
